desc:
Stick packs of individually wrapped classic chews in a tasty bite‑sized cola‑flavoured square, bursting with fresh cola taste. They’re gelatine‑free and contain no artificial colours - mouth‑watering deliciousness from Chewits.

Chewits · Sticks
ingredients: glucose syrup, sugar, vegetable fats (palm, coconut), acids (lactic acid, citric acid), concentrate from (carrot, apple, hibiscus, molasses, blackcurrant), flavouring, EGG white powder, hydrolysed pea protein.
